name: ReflectiveCard-TS-TW
title: Webcam Reflective Card
description: A tall frosted-metal ID card that mirrors whatever the webcam sees behind a blurred, grainy silver surface. White text shows a name and job title, a secure-access badge, an ID number and a fingerprint mark.
use: You want a login or profile card that shows a live, stylised camera view of the user as a security pass.
avoid: It needs camera permission; without a working webcam the surface stays blank grey and the white text is low contrast.
a11y: It requests the camera on mount with no visible fallback, and white text over a bright live surface is very low contrast. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall rounded card filled by a light grey, grainy, blurred metal surface with a bright glow drifting across the middle. White uppercase text sits over it: a small badge and activity icon at the top, the name ALEXANDER DOE with SENIOR DEVELOPER beneath, and an ID number above a fingerprint icon.
behaves: The surface reflects the live camera feed through a blurred, monochrome, metallic filter, so the sheen and grain shift as the scene in front of the camera moves. The overlay text and badge stay fixed.
customise: Props tune blur strength, text colour, metalness, roughness, overlay colour, displacement, noise scale, specular, grayscale and distortion. The name, title, badge and ID text are fixed in the source.
weight: moderate: A live video stream runs an SVG turbulence and displacement filter on every frame.
demo: Name ALEXANDER DOE, title SENIOR DEVELOPER, badge SECURE ACCESS and ID number 8901-2345-6789.
issues: The catalogue says the glare tracks the cursor, but the code has no pointer handlers; only the webcam changes.
The white name, badge and ID text sit on a bright surface with very low contrast.
Camera permission is requested on load with no visible fallback when it is denied.
polishWhy: Distinctive metallic surface, but the washed-out reflection buries the text and detail.
